name: clipboard-history
description: Clipboard history for Windows that opens at your text cursor without stealing focus
author: Fatih Akyol

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
